slides.title: Fixer, peacekeeper, or *joker*?
slides.sub: The role you slip into in a group.

slides.title: Notice the role
slides.body: In a room full of people, most of us fall into a part. Smoothing things over. Solving everyone's problem. Breaking the tension with a joke.

slides.title: What does it protect?
slides.body: When did you learn this part? What might happen if nobody played it tonight?

slides.title: Put it down once
slides.body: For one evening, let the tension sit. Let someone else fix it. Skip the joke you'd usually make.

slides.title: Then notice
slides.body: What did you feel in the gap where the role used to go? Who are you when you're not playing it?
